Modify Image 1 only by adding one tasteful logo-and-title header in the empty dark sky immediately ABOVE the centered login card. Preserve the complete screenshot composition, aspect ratio, background spacecraft, wormhole, planet, colors, existing panel position, all UI controls, and all existing UI text. The header must appear directly on the existing background as if a transparent PNG were overlaid: absolutely no rectangular banner backdrop, added nebula, plaque, outline box, black rectangle, decorative line, or glow cloud. Preserve the existing dark sky around and behind it. Use only a soft very subtle shadow and faint cyan rim light for contrast. Keep the visual energy subordinate to the readability and elegance of the full login screen.

Output one full-screen proposed mockup at the SAME aspect ratio and framing as Image 1. The only new content is the compact transparent-looking emblem/title above the card. No explanatory annotations, mockup labels, arrows or watermark.
